task: Pre-rollout readiness check for the book_tab_front_door layout found --border-strong referenced twice in components.css (from the earlier 70ed5c54 book-layout commit) with no matching definition in tokens.css, silently rendering the series-position pill/stepper border as invisible/wrong-colored. Added the missing token in both themes.

frontend/src/theme/tokens.css.summary: Added --border-strong token (light: #c3cbdb, dark: #5a6480) next to --border/--border-muted, closing a gap where components.css referenced an undefined custom property for the series-position pill border and the stepper's hover border-color.
